human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add an import service that validates one package, creates or matches an external run record, and appends normalized evidence exactly once. Re-importing the identical package must be a no-op success; conflicting same-run content must be reported instead of duplicated. Dependency: 8006.validate-runtime-evidence-v1.
human_pressure.why_now: Dashboard/report data must come from stored canonical evidence, not direct package scanning.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No projection/dashboard computation in import service.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Implement idempotent package-to-SQLite import with explicit source/package identity.
red_lines: No projection/dashboard computation in import service.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8006.validate-runtime-evidence-v1. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Raw stored evidence is sufficient to rebuild projection.
Import does not reinterpret source decision domains.
contracts: Import consumes EvidencePackage, not runtime-private directories.
failure_semantics: Validation failure returns import failure without normal projection; content identity conflict is explicit.

steps.title: Define import result
details: created/already_present/conflict, run_id, event counts, source digest.

steps.title: Create external run deterministically
details: Use source-neutral metadata to mark imported runtime/source schema.

steps.title: Append events idempotently
details: Stable event IDs prevent duplicate insertion.
Detect same event ID with different content as conflict.

steps.title: Test repeated import
details: Second identical import does not increase counts.

acceptance: Identical package can be imported repeatedly without duplicate events.
Source run_id remains the Ailuros run_id for imported evidence unless collision policy explicitly says otherwise.

must_check: No projection is needed for import success.
reject_if: Invalid package partially persists as a normal clean run.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Focused import/idempotency tests plus existing loader/validator coverage.
